config.isaac_disaster.title: Isaac's Disasterconfig
config.isaac_disaster.subtitle: Choose a config category
config.isaac_disaster.server_notice: These are local gameplay settings; server rules cannot be changed when connected to a remote server.
config.isaac_disaster.entry.active_item_: active item durability restored every 4 ticks
config.isaac_disaster.entry.limited_acti: when enabled, only active items in the main hand and offhand recharge automatically
config.isaac_disaster.entry.active_item_: whether active items recharge over time
config.isaac_disaster.entry.allow_curio_: whetherallow removing items from Curios slots
config.isaac_disaster.entry.item_removal: whether generated items are removed from the corresponding pool
when enabled, overrides current-pool removal and removes the item from all players' pools
config.isaac_disaster.entry.players_shar: whether all players share the same item pools
config.isaac_disaster.entry.auto_use_pas: whether to automatically use passive items when obtained
config.isaac_disaster.entry.time_stop_ex: when enabled, entities classified as friendly to the time-stop source, including pets and teammates, are not affected
config.isaac_disaster.entry.allow_same_m: when disabled, use the source with the largest adjustment for each multiplier ID; when enabled, calculate all sources and quantities
